overall_notes: This paper is primarily an analysis of position embeddings in Transformers rather than a comprehensive NLG evaluation. The NLG tasks (language modeling and machine translation) are used as testbeds to analyze how different position embeddings affect performance, but the main contribution is understanding position embedding properties. The metadata extraction was mostly accurate, but this is more of a model analysis paper than an NLG evaluation paper.
